reason: The README describes a Rust-based CLI and MCP integration that lets AI agents use DeepSeek web vision and OCR capabilities, including multi-image analysis, text extraction, login management, and agent configuration. Its primary user-facing purpose is image understanding and OCR, with external network access, browser login automation, and local credential storage.

summaries.zh: 通过 CLI、MCP 或 DeepSeek Harness 将 DeepSeek 网页版视觉模型和 OCR 能力提供给 AI 助手，用于图片分析与文字提取。
summaries.en: Connects AI assistants to DeepSeek web vision and OCR capabilities through CLI, MCP, or DeepSeek Harness for image analysis and text extraction.

capabilities: Analyzes images and extracts text through DeepSeek vision and OCR tools
Exposes functionality through CLI, MCP, and DeepSeek Harness integrations
Uploads image data to the DeepSeek web backend over HTTPS
Automates browser-based login and stores authentication tokens and session data locally
Writes agent integration configuration and skill files
